sources.title: Cars24 expects to be eligible to file DRHP by Apr: CFO
Cars24 Eyes April 2027 Reverse Flip Ahead Of IPO Filing

synopsis: Cars24 expects to be eligible to file its draft red herring prospectus by April after completing its reverse flip from Singapore to India, a process taking six to nine months, according to CFO Shivanshu Makkar. The company, which last raised funds in 2022 at a 3.3 billion dollar post-money valuation, plans an IPO to create a war chest for expansion into newer cities and geographies including the Gulf region and Australia, as well as to provide liquidity to shareholders and employees. Makkar noted that the IPO will also serve as a stamp on internal governance. No deal value, stake percentage, buyers, or advisers were mentioned.
